# The North Road

A scene is a map: placements, fog and the layer that draws them. It is semiplane's
kind rather than the plugin's, so the map layer renders a scene without knowing
any rules.

![[maps/greyhaven.png]]

## Placements

- [[objects|The Grey Warden]] at the gate.
- Three [[bestiary/goblin|goblins]] on the north road.
- The mill, which [[journal]] says is where the tracks lead.
